people.imagined: Late afternoon in the lease office. She sits upright behind the scale with a fan held low to hide the tremor in her left hand, and smiles at a buyer she has already decided to bargain with.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a counter she holds a closed folding fan against her left wrist and smiles at the viewer with a trader's composure. Face (most important: a vermilion coat of fine silk, bright against the rest): a handsome, strong-boned face with a firm chin, arched black brows, almond dark eyes with a measuring brightness, a full mouth painted a deep red-brown, a faint line from each nostril; a trace of tiredness under the eyes. Hair: black with a few silver threads, in a high elegant coil held by two gold pins with cinnabar-red beads. Body: upright, composed, strong shoulders. Clothing: a long coat of fine vermilion silk with a stiff standing collar and wide cuffs, bright orange-red, a darker red sash, a pale undershirt collar; thin oiled-silk gloves of pale yellow on her hands. Hands and objects: a closed black-lacquered folding fan held tight in the left hand against the left wrist to hide a faint tremor; the right hand rests lightly on a small brass balance beside her. Background: a dim warm office, a shelf of small clay pill jars. Light: warm golden light from the upper left, a vermilion glow on her face. Expression: a pleasant, composed smile with the eyes level and unreadable, chin lifted a touch, giving nothing away.

people.imagined: In the sealed room, blind, he smells the air before anyone speaks. His hands rest on the bronze gourd. He has just recognised a footstep.
people.subject: The moment: seated in a dark sealed room, he turns his face a little upward and sniffs the air, hands resting on a bronze gourd, eyes open and cloudy. Face (most important: clouded milk-white eyes, wide open and blind, and silver skin): a gaunt, long, old face with skin of a pale silvery grey sheen, high hollow cheekbones, a thin hooked nose, both eyes filmed with a milky white cloud with no pupil visible, a long thin white moustache and a wispy beard to the chest; deep vertical lines in the cheeks. Hair: long white hair, brushed straight back and tied at the nape with a faded red cord. Body: bone-thin, upright, small. Clothing: a long robe of pale grey-brown cotton stained with dull cinnabar red at the cuffs, the hem and the sleeves, a stiff collar, the fabric washed soft and clean, a black cloth belt. Hands and objects: both thin hands rest on top of a squat bronze gourd the size of a melon with nine faint bands around it, a thread of pale smoke curling from its neck. Background: a plain dark room, a small bronze censer on the floor at one side. Light: a faint warm glow from the upper left, low and dim. Expression: a very still face tilted upward, clouded open eyes unfocused, nostrils flared slightly, lips set in a patient line.

people.imagined: In the mercury room, in his mask, he stands watching the others. He has just lifted the mask to eat and has not set it down. He carried a body out of this room once.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a dim room, he holds a leather mask with two round glass eyes in his left hand at chest level, his own face just uncovered, grim and tired. Face (most important: the leather mask with round glass eyes held up beside his face, and the deep strap line across his cheeks): a thin, narrow, sallow face with a deep red groove across both cheeks and the bridge of the nose from the mask strap, grey-green pallor, thin lips pressed hard, sunken eyes with dark lids, a long pointed nose, a thin grey goatee; the skin looking waxy. Hair: thinning black and grey, flattened by the mask, tied in a small knot. Body: thin, stooped a little, narrow chest. Clothing: a vermilion coat of heavy waxed cloth to the knee with a buttoned high collar, rubbed grey at the cuffs, a leather apron over it, long gloves of oiled pale yellow silk to the elbow. Hands and objects: the left hand holds up a brown leather mask with two round glass lenses and a cloth strap; the right hand gloved, holding a long iron stirring rod. Background: a dark room with a faint silver shimmer of mercury in a trough. Light: cold light from the upper left, a silver glint on the glass eyes. Expression: a hard, tired stare with deep shadows under the eyes, a severe set mouth and a stiff, lifted chin, the skin marked where the mask pressed.

people.imagined: At the diggings she grins at a washer and her teeth show pink, her big red hands on her hips. She has just sent a sick man home with a pouch.
people.subject: The moment: standing among red-brown troughs she grins wide with her hands on her hips, looking right at the viewer. Face (most important: a wide grin with pink-stained teeth, and big red hands): a broad, strong, sunburnt face with a heavy jaw, a big mouth open in a grin that shows teeth tinted pink with cinnabar dust, small bright eyes, thick brows, red dust in the lines of the face. Her nose is wide, her eyebrows are heavy and dusted red at the tips, and her laugh lines are deep around the pink-tinted teeth. Hair: black, braided tight and wound round the head, a red kerchief over it. Body: big, tall, broad in the shoulders and hips, forearms thick. Clothing: a short vermilion coat with the sleeves rolled to the elbow, a leather apron stained rust-red, sturdy trousers; a rag mask hanging at her throat. A thick scarf of red-stained cloth is knotted at her neck and the apron has a big square pocket full of small stones, and her boots are caked with rust-red mud. Hands and objects: both hands on her hips, large and red to the wrist from dust, fingers spread; a rolled pouch of herbs tucked at the belt. Background: red-brown washing troughs and a dusty badland slope. Rows of long wooden troughs run down a slope of rust-red earth, with washers bent over them like small dark figures. Light: hard dry sunlight from the upper left. A cloud of fine red dust hangs in the air and turns the light a warm brick colour. Expression: a broad hearty grin showing pink-stained teeth, crinkled eyes that stay steady on the viewer, the warmth a little too practised.

people.imagined: At the market stall he pats his pill-purse like a faithful dog and calls to a passer-by. He has never been caught short on a weight.
people.subject: The moment: standing behind a market counter, he pats a fat embroidered purse with his right hand and beams at the viewer with a seller's welcome, the look of a man who has never been caught short on a weight. Face (most important: a thin, glossy black moustache curled up at both ends into two neat points): a round, cheerful, pink face with a double chin, bright dark eyes with a twinkle in them, a gap-toothed grin, and a little black goatee below the lip. Hair: black, oiled flat and slick against the skull, gathered into a tidy small knot under a small round cap of vermilion silk. Body: plump and short, with a round chest and soft shoulders, standing square behind the counter. Clothing: a vermilion coat of good silk fastened with brass buttons, a pale yellow vest beneath it, a gold-edged cuff on each sleeve, and a pair of thin oiled gloves tucked into his belt. Hands and objects: the right hand pats a plump red cloth purse tied with a gold cord; on the counter in front of him stands a small brass balance with one tiny pill resting on a pan. Background: a blurred market in warm colours, awning cloth striped in red and cream, the shapes of other stalls and shoppers softly out of focus. Light: bright market daylight from the upper left, catching the brass of the balance and the shine on his moustache. Expression: a warm, practised grin that reaches the eyes, the open, coaxing face of a man sure he will make the sale.

people.imagined: In the washing shed he coughs, a fist at his mouth, one hand stained sulphur yellow. He teaches through every cough.
people.subject: The moment: in a steamy washing shed he coughs into his closed left fist and glares over it at the viewer, still lecturing. Face (most important: the left hand stained bright sulphur yellow from fingertips to wrist, held up at the mouth): a lined, sour, grey-brown face with a bent nose, thick bristling brows over red-rimmed eyes, deep creases beside the mouth, lips tinged faintly blue, and a short grey beard stained yellowish at the chin. Hair: grey and scant, tied in a small knot with a strip of vermilion cloth. Body: broad and a little hunched, with a barrel chest that heaves with each cough. Clothing: a vermilion coat of waxed cloth, clean and well cut, with the sleeves pushed up to the elbow, a stained work apron over it, and a cloth mask pulled down so it hangs at his chin. Hands and objects: the yellow left fist at his mouth, the right hand gripping a long wooden paddle used for stirring the troughs. Background: the shed itself, wooden troughs of red and yellow slurry in rows, damp beams, steam hanging under the roof. Light: damp light from the upper left, with a yellow tint in the steam that drifts across his face. Expression: an irritated, stubborn scowl, brows drawn together and the jaw pushed forward, a teacher interrupted by his own barking cough and angry about it.

people.imagined: She guides the Mistress's trembling hand and signs the lease returns herself when needed; ink along the side of her right hand. A brush-reed pins her grey hair.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a desk, she holds a fine brush steady above a page and looks up warmly at the viewer. Face (most important: ash-grey hair pinned with a long reed brush): a kind, narrow, soft-featured face with a gentle long nose, grey-green eyes with small crow's-feet, an easy mouth and smooth pale skin with a hint of tiredness; her hair has gone early to ash grey. Hair: ash grey, drawn into a smooth knot at the back of the head with a long slender reed brush pushed through it like a hairpin. Body: slender, quiet and straight-backed, sitting upright with her elbows close in. Clothing: a vermilion long coat of fine cotton with a narrow white collar and a neat band of darker red at each sleeve, clean, simple and carefully pressed. Hands and objects: the right hand holds the brush above the page, the whole outer edge of that hand blackened with ink from wrist to little finger; the left hand lightly steadies an empty sheet. Background: a plain desk with an ink stone and a closed book, no visible writing, and a pale wall behind. Light: soft window light from the upper left, giving a gentle shadow under the cheekbone. Expression: a calm, steady, kindly look, the slight lift at the corner of the mouth of someone who is patient and means to be helpful, with a careful watchfulness in the eyes.

people.imagined: She stands unmasked in the mercury room among grey faces, rosy and healthy, one dark fingernail held up. She breathes the air without fear, and she is proud of it.
people.subject: The moment: standing without any mask, she smiles brightly and a little coldly at the viewer, her right hand raised to show one dark fingernail. Face (most important: rosy cheeks, healthy and glowing, with no mask line): a round, rosy, healthy face with bright pink cheeks and clear skin, wide dark eyes with a hard glitter, thin upturned brows, a neat red mouth in a sweet smile; no mask marks at all. Her lashes are long and her eyebrows neat, and her lips are a natural bright rose with a small dimple at the left corner. Hair: black, in two high round buns tied with red cord. Body: small, straight, brisk. Clothing: a trim vermilion coat with buttoned collar, sleeves with white piping, a bright red sash, thin pale gloves tucked into the belt. The collar of her coat is edged with white piping, and a row of small bone buttons runs down the front, each polished. Hands and objects: the right hand raised, palm in, one black fingernail on the middle finger clearly visible; the left holds a small silver spoon. Background: pale grey walls and a row of masked grey figures blurred. The grey figures behind her wear leather masks and stand in a long row in front of silver troughs. Light: cool light from the upper left. The cool grey light makes the roses of her cheeks the only colour in the room. Expression: a bright smile that stops short of her eyes, which watch the viewer keenly and coolly, her chin raised.

people.imagined: She has just pulled off her mask in the corridor, leaving a deep line across both cheeks. She is writing a letter in her head to her aunt.
people.subject: The moment: she lowers a leather mask from her face, in a dim corridor, and looks at the viewer with pale tired eyes. Face (most important: a deep red strap line cut across both cheeks, pale ring around the eyes): a narrow pale face, the skin around both eyes ghost-white, a dark red groove from the mask strap cutting across both cheeks and over the ears, tired grey eyes, thin brows, chapped lips; a haunted, fine-boned look. Her lips are pale and a little cracked, her eyelids are faintly translucent, and a fine web of tiny lines surrounds the eyes. Hair: black, in a plain low knot flattened by the strap. Body: small and thin, narrow shoulders. Clothing: a vermilion coat of plain cloth with a stiff collar, sleeves ending in oiled yellow gloves, a leather cord around her neck. The collar of her coat is buttoned high and the cuffs are tied with cord, and the yellow gloves are mended at the thumb with neat stitches. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a brown leather mask with round glass eyes, hanging from her fingers by its strap. Background: a dim corridor with a single lamp. A long wooden bench along the wall holds rows of leather masks hung from pegs, and a single door at the end of the corridor glows faintly silver. Light: low lamp light from the upper left. The lamp throws a pale yellow circle, leaving her face half in shadow and her eyes dark. Expression: pale tired eyes with a faint wary tension, a slight downturn of the mouth and a deep pressed line across both cheeks.

people.imagined: At the stall he turns the pill-scale pendant in his fingers and greets a stranger like an old friend, with a very open grin.
people.subject: The moment: he leans forward over a stall counter with a wide friendly grin, turning a small brass pendant between his fingers. Face: a bright, round, open face with a wide grin and big teeth, quick shining brown eyes, thick eyebrows, ears that stick out a little, a smooth chin; a look of boyish ease. His grin shows a slightly crooked front tooth and his ears flare like handles, with a few freckles across the cheekbones. Hair: black, tied in a short high tail with a red cord. Body: lean and quick, lanky. Clothing: a vermilion coat with the cuffs rolled, a clean white collar, a leather pouch strapped across his chest. A small brass scale-shaped pendant hangs on his chest, and the pouch strap is stitched with red thread, and his sleeves are cuffed back neatly. Hands and objects: a tiny brass pendant shaped like a two-pan scale hung on a cord, twirled in the right hand at chest height; a covered tray of small pill jars on the counter in front. Background: a bright blurred market with striped awnings. Awnings of red and cream stripes cross the top of the picture and a seller's round cart stands behind him with brass weights on it. Light: bright light from the upper left. The strong sunlight puts a bright spark on the pendant and a warm glow on his teeth. Expression: ambitious, gregarious and deceitful; a friendly look that is just a little too wide.

people.imagined: A miner's son proud that he did not cough. He puffs his chest out at the word crusts, and his lips move as he repeats what he was told.
people.subject: The moment: standing very straight with his chest puffed out, he looks at the viewer with proud, simple eyes, lips moving as if repeating an instruction. Face (most important: the puffed chest and the proud open face): a wide, honest, slow face with a broad flat nose, round dark eyes, thick short brows, a large mouth pursed mid-word, sunburnt cheeks with a yellowish dust on the forehead. His eyebrows are thick and sandy with yellow dust and his chin is broad and slightly cleft, and his ears are red at the edges. Hair: coarse black hair, cut short and uneven. Body: stocky, broad, chest thrown out hard. Clothing: a vermilion coat a bit too small across the chest, buttons straining, a plain grey undershirt, a washed apron; thick fingerless gloves of oiled cloth. The coat is buttoned across the chest with a button hanging by one thread, and the apron is stained yellow near the hem. Hands and objects: one fist thumped on his own chest; in the other hand a small shovel-like wooden paddle held upright like a banner. Background: a pale yellow badland slope with a row of low sheds. Rows of low sheds stand on pale yellow ground, with heaps of sulphur crust in rough lumps and a wheelbarrow tipped on its side. Light: dusty daylight from the upper left. A faint yellow haze of dust lies in the air and warms the whole picture. Expression: an earnest, simple face with chest-forward pride, round open eyes and a small tight smile, lips still shaping the words.

people.imagined: He tucks his shaking hands under his arms so no one sees; he is thinking of the pay he sends home.
people.subject: The moment: he stands with both hands tucked tightly under his folded arms, looking at the viewer with a faint, trusting, anxious smile. Face (most important: arms crossed with the hands hidden in the armpits, the shoulders hunched): a thin, mild, farm-boy face with round brown eyes, a snub nose, a few spots on the forehead, a soft hopeful mouth, hollow cheeks; faint tremor in the blurred lines of the chin. His nose is slightly red and his lips are chapped, and a few boyish pimples dot his forehead, with a worried crease between the brows. Hair: brown, soft, short and sticking up. Body: thin, narrow-shouldered, hunched. Clothing: a vermilion coat hand-me-down too big in the sleeves, the cuffs folded back twice, a coarse linen shirt beneath, a rope belt. The hand-me-down coat has a patch on the left shoulder in a different red, and the coin bag at his neck is sewn from a scrap of blue cloth. Hands and objects: both hands hidden, pressed under the opposite arms; a tiny knotted bag of coins hanging at his neck. Background: a barley-field edge and a pale sky behind a trough shed. A narrow path leads down to rows of low barley fields in the distance and a stack of ore baskets is piled by the shed. Light: soft daylight from the upper left. The pale daylight leaves his face slightly washed out and his eyes bright. Expression: a small, trying smile held over uneasy eyes, brows slightly raised and the jaw tight.

people.imagined: She leans on a spade in the barley field beside a new mound. Her face is weathered brown beyond her years, her hands square from digging.
people.subject: The moment: she stands with both hands on the handle of a spade planted in the earth, looking down at a new low mound and then up at the viewer, solemn. Face (most important: a weathered brown face, older than its years, and square spade-worn hands): a broad plain face weathered brown and chapped well before its time, strong cheekbones, calm dark eyes, a firm straight mouth; skin chapped and tanned. Her nose is flat and wide, a small frown line crosses her forehead, and her lips are chapped and held firm, with a faint dust of earth at her temples. Hair: black, cut at the jaw, tied back with a plain cloth band. Body: stocky, broad shoulders and strong arms. Clothing: a vermilion coat worn plain over a grey tunic, sleeves rolled to the elbow, an old but clean apron, mud on the boots. The coat is faded from red to orange at the shoulders and the apron has a mended tear, and a plain wooden stake is tied at her belt. Hands and objects: both big square hands gripping the handle of a flat-bladed iron spade stuck in the ground; behind her a small low grave mound with a plain wooden stake. Background: golden barley fields and a low pale sky. A row of low mounds extends toward the horizon, each with a plain stake and a tuft of barley. Light: soft late-afternoon light from the upper left. The evening light turns the barley gold and lengthens the shadow of the spade across the earth. Expression: a solemn, steady face with a sad downward mouth and weathered eyes that hold the viewer's gaze without flinching.

people.imagined: He balances the founder's meal tray up the stairs and laughs before the joke arrives, thumbs calloused from the tray.
people.subject: The moment: mid-laugh, he balances a lacquer meal tray on both palms and looks at the viewer with a wide grin, about to tell a joke before the joke has arrived. Face (most important: a big open laughing mouth in a very skinny face): a narrow, boyish face with sharp cheekbones, a wide mouth open in a laugh, bright dark eyes squeezed into crescents, a sharp chin, a long neck with a big Adam's apple, and a faint crease between the brows from habit. Hair: black, a short unruly tuft that will not lie flat. Body: very skinny and lanky, elbows stuck out to keep the tray level. Clothing: a vermilion coat a little loose on his thin shoulders, the sleeves tied back above the elbow with string for work, a white apron with a dark soup stain near the pocket, and a rope belt; the cloth is clean and good, only the apron shows the day's work. Hands and objects: a lacquer tray carrying a covered bowl and a tiny cup rests on the flat of both palms, his thumbs thick with callus along the rim; steam curls up from the bowl. Background: a narrow wooden stair rising into the dark, a lantern hung from a nail, and a second tray stacked on a shelf. Light: warm yellow lantern light from the upper left, throwing his laughing shadow large on the wall. Expression: a sly, delighted mischief, the grin of a boy who is fond of everyone he serves and cannot resist teasing them.

people.imagined: Back from the hills with a basket of roots, scratched by the last bramble, he holds up a bunch of angelica for a girl he is courting.
people.subject: The moment: he holds up a bunch of pale-flowered angelica stalks, roots still dirty, toward the viewer and grins, back from the hills with a thin bramble scratch on his cheek, courting a girl with a gift of roots. Face (most important: a long red scratch across the left cheek, and soil under every nail): a handsome, sun-browned, restless face, a jaunty grin with cracked lips, quick brown eyes, slightly crooked brows, a little stubble with a leaf stuck in it, and a thin line of rust-red beads along the scratch. Hair: tousled brown hair with a twig caught in it. Body: lean, wiry and quick, leaning forward as he presents the flowers. Clothing: a vermilion coat of good cloth with a green scarf knotted at his neck, mud-caked boots from the hill, and a woven basket on his back held by braided bark straps. Hands and objects: the right hand holds up the angelica, white umbels on long stalks with dirty roots; the fingernails are black with soil. Background: a hillside of mountain scrub, brambles and pale rock under a pale sky, with a mountain eagle small in the distance. Light: bright hill light from the upper left, showing the dirt under his nails and the white umbels. Expression: a winning, restless grin with a flash of calculation behind it, the look of a young man who means every promise at the moment he makes it.

people.imagined: In the sealed room she reads the market prices aloud to the blind founder, a cord of her father's brass tags on her wrist. She is learning the ninth turn by smell.
people.subject: The moment: she kneels beside a low table and holds a covered bowl toward a dark doorway, turning her head to the viewer with a patient look. Face: a round, soft, honest face with full cheeks, gentle dark eyes, level brows, a small straight nose, a calm mouth, a mole on the chin and the faint dark circles of long nights; a tiny brass stud in each small ear. Hair: black, in a neat low bun held with a plain wooden pin. Body: round-shouldered and sturdy, the build of a washer's daughter, kneeling upright. Clothing: a vermilion coat with a clean white collar and a narrow band at each sleeve, a plain apron over it, the sash tied in a double bow; a faint red stain marks the cuffs from the work, and there are no gloves. Hands and objects (the cord is the lead): on the left wrist a cord strung with six small brass tags, each stamped with a plain notch, jingling as she moves; both hands hold a lidded bowl with a wisp of steam. Background: a dim room with a curl of pale smoke at one side, a low table holding a small lamp and a row of covered bowls, the faint haze of herbs hanging in the air. Light: low warm light from the upper left, soft on her hands and the brass tags. Expression: a patient, cautious gentleness, brows slightly raised and the mouth closed, the honest look of someone who keeps careful count of everything and means no harm.

people.imagined: In a pressed collar, clean among the grey faces, he signs a ledger with ink-stained fingers and glances up bored.
people.subject: The moment: he leans back in a chair with a brush in his inked fingers and gazes at the viewer with idle self-satisfaction. Face (most important: the crisp pressed white collar and a town-clean look): a smooth pale young face, a well-shaped nose, half-lidded bright eyes, an arrogant arched brow, a slight sneer, not one speck of dust on him. His eyebrows are neatly shaped, his lips are slightly full, and his skin is clear with a faint town-bred paleness. Hair: black and glossy, combed into a neat top-knot with a jade pin. Body: slim, easy, slouched. Clothing: a vermilion coat of the finest cloth, freshly pressed, a stiff white collar with sharp folds, a silk sash with a gold clasp, clean pale boots. The white collar has a hand's breadth of folded linen and the coat sleeves are lined with pale cream silk, and a small silver ring sits on his left forefinger. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a brush, the fingertips and side of the hand stained with black ink; a small abacus on the desk beside. Background: a tidy desk with a tea cup and a stack of blank sheets. A teacup of fine thin porcelain stands on the desk with a fan and a brass paperweight, and the shelf behind holds neat rows of boxes. Light: soft clean light from the upper left. The soft light makes his clothes seem almost bright against the dusty room. Expression: half-lidded, bored eyes and a faint self-satisfied curl of the lips, the chin tipped back and the whole face at ease.

people.imagined: Memorial of the co-founder at the furnace in 1141, brave and impatient, teaching the furnace to a young woman, the room behind her filling with fume.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting with the edges darkened, of an older woman at a furnace turning to the viewer with a generous, impatient look. Face: a broad, strong, warm face weathered by the diggings, with wide cheekbones, thick brows, bright dark eyes, a big mouth in a half-smile, deep laugh lines and a faint red dusty tint at the cheeks. Hair: long black with grey streaks, tied in a bold high knot with a plain red cord. Body: broad and strong, square-shouldered, a woman who has lifted crucibles all her life. Clothing: a long vermilion coat of waxed cloth with the sleeves rolled to the elbow, a sturdy leather apron whose edges are darkened by years at the fire, long gloves of oiled silk, and a cloth mask pulled down below the chin. Hands and objects: the right hand holds long iron tongs lifting a small round crucible glowing orange; the left is raised, palm out, as if telling someone to hurry. Background: a dim furnace room with a painted canopy of nine small stars above and faint smoke rising, a young woman's shape half seen at the edge learning at her side. Light: orange furnace glow from the lower right, fading toward old-silk yellow at the edges of the painting. Expression: a generous, impatient half-smile, the eyes bright and a little bossy, a teacher who has given the same command a hundred times and loves the pupil for it.
